mapper.select: SELECT encode(h.id, 'hex') AS "id", h.spu_id AS "spuId", encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.stock_quantity AS "skuStockQuantity", s.status AS "skuStatus", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.status AS "status", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version", h.created_at AS "createdAt", h.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM product_hot_sku h INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id WHERE h.spu_id = #{spuId} ORDER BY h.updated_at DESC, h.created_at DESC

SELECT encode(h.id, 'hex') AS "id", h.spu_id AS "spuId", encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.stock_quantity AS "skuStockQuantity", s.status AS "skuStatus", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.status AS "status", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version", h.created_at AS "createdAt", h.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM product_hot_sku h INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id WHERE h.spu_id = #{spuId} AND h.sku_id = #{skuId}

SELECT encode(h.id, 'hex') AS "id", h.spu_id AS "spuId", p.name AS "spuName", p.subtitle AS "spuSubtitle", p.brand_name AS "brandName", p.main_image_url AS "mainImageUrl", p.category_id AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.stock_quantity AS "skuStockQuantity", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.status AS "status", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version", h.created_at AS "createdAt", h.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM product_hot_sku h INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = h.spu_id INNER JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE h.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (h.start_at IS NULL OR h.start_at <= #{now}) AND (h.end_at IS NULL OR h.end_at > #{now}) ORDER BY h.updated_at DESC, h.created_at DESC, h.sku_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT encode(h.id, 'hex') AS "id", h.spu_id AS "spuId", p.name AS "spuName", p.subtitle AS "spuSubtitle", p.brand_name AS "brandName", p.main_image_url AS "mainImageUrl", p.category_id AS "categoryId", c.name AS "categoryName", encode(h.sku_id, 'hex') AS "skuId", s.sku_code AS "skuCode", s.sku_name AS "skuName", s.stock_quantity AS "skuStockQuantity", h.stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", h.remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", h.status AS "status", h.start_at AS "startAt", h.end_at AS "endAt", h.version AS "version", h.created_at AS "createdAt", h.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM product_hot_sku h INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = h.spu_id INNER JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE h.sku_id = #{skuId} AND h.status = 'ENABLED' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (h.start_at IS NULL OR h.start_at <= #{now}) AND (h.end_at IS NULL OR h.end_at > #{now})

WITH target_spu AS ( SELECT id FROM product_spu WHERE id = #{spuId} ), incoming AS ( SELECT raw.sku_id AS sku_id, raw.sku_id_bytes_hex AS sku_id_bytes_hex, raw.hot_id_bytes_hex AS hot_id_bytes_hex, raw.stock_quantity AS stock_quantity, raw.status AS status, raw.start_at_epoch_ms AS start_at_epoch_ms, raw.end_at_epoch_ms AS end_at_epoch_ms FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( sku_id text, sku_id_bytes_hex text, hot_id_bytes_hex text, stock_quantity integer, status text, start_at_epoch_ms bigint, end_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ), normalized AS ( SELECT sku_id, decode(sku_id_bytes_hex, 'hex') AS sku_id_bytes, decode(hot_id_bytes_hex, 'hex') AS hot_id_bytes, stock_quantity, status, CASE WHEN start_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(start_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END AS start_at, CASE WHEN end_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(end_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END AS end_at FROM incoming ), target_sku AS ( SELECT n.*, s.stock_quantity AS db_stock_quantity, s.status AS sku_status FROM normalized n LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.spu_id = #{spuId} AND s.id = n.sku_id_bytes ), stats AS ( SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target_spu) AS spu_exists, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalized) AS requested_count, COUNT(db_stock_quantity) AS matched_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE db_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL AND sku_status != 'ACTIVE') AS inactive_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE db_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL AND (stock_quantity IS NULL OR stock_quantity <= 0 OR stock_quantity > db_stock_quantity) ) AS stock_invalid_count FROM target_sku ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO product_hot_sku ( id, spu_id, sku_id, stock_quantity, remaining_quantity, status, start_at, end_at ) SELECT t.hot_id_bytes, #{spuId}, t.sku_id_bytes, t.stock_quantity, t.stock_quantity, t.status, t.start_at, t.end_at FROM target_sku t CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE st.spu_exists = true AND st.requested_count = st.matched_count AND st.inactive_count = 0 AND st.stock_invalid_count = 0 ON CONFLICT (sku_id) DO UPDATE SET stock_quantity = EXCLUDED.stock_quantity, remaining_quantity = EXCLUDED.remaining_quantity, status = EXCLUDED.status, start_at = EXCLUDED.start_at, end_at = EXCLUDED.end_at, version = product_hot_sku.version + 1, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING sku_id, stock_quantity, remaining_quantity, status, start_at, end_at, version ) SELECT (SELECT spu_exists FROM stats) AS "spuExists", (SELECT requested_count FROM stats) AS "requestedCount", (SELECT matched_count FROM stats) AS "matchedCount", (SELECT inactive_count FROM stats) AS "inactiveCount", (SELECT stock_invalid_count FROM stats) AS "stockInvalidCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted) AS "affectedCount", COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'skuId', encode(upserted.sku_id, 'hex'), 'stockQuantity', upserted.stock_quantity, 'remainingQuantity', upserted.remaining_quantity, 'status', upserted.status, 'startAtEpochMs', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM upserted.start_at) * 1000)::bigint, 'endAtEpochMs', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM upserted.end_at) * 1000)::bigint, 'version', upserted.version, 'pointExchangeEnabled', s.point_exchange_enabled, 'pointExchangePoints', s.point_exchange_points ) ) FROM upserted INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = upserted.sku_id ), '[]'::jsonb)::text AS "redisItemsJson"

WITH raw AS ( SELECT raw.sku_id_hex AS sku_id_hex, raw.sku_id_text AS sku_id_text, raw.remaining_quantity AS remaining_quantity FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( sku_id_hex text, sku_id_text text, remaining_quantity integer ) ), incoming AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (decode(sku_id_hex, 'hex')) decode(sku_id_hex, 'hex') AS sku_id, sku_id_text, remaining_quantity FROM raw WHERE sku_id_hex IS NOT NULL AND sku_id_hex ~ '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{32}$' AND remaining_quantity IS NOT NULL AND remaining_quantity >= 0 ORDER BY decode(sku_id_hex, 'hex'), sku_id_text ), matched AS ( SELECT i.sku_id, i.sku_id_text, i.remaining_quantity AS new_remaining_quantity, h.remaining_quantity AS old_remaining_quantity, h.stock_quantity AS hot_stock_quantity, s.stock_quantity AS sku_stock_quantity, i.remaining_quantity - h.remaining_quantity AS quantity_diff FROM incoming i INNER JOIN product_hot_sku h ON h.sku_id = i.sku_id INNER JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = h.sku_id ), stats AS ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incoming) AS requested_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS matched_count, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched WHERE new_remaining_quantity > hot_stock_quantity OR sku_stock_quantity + quantity_diff < 0 ), 0) AS invalid_count ), valid_target AS ( SELECT m.* FROM matched m CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE st.invalid_count = 0 ), updated_hot AS ( UPDATE product_hot_sku h SET remaining_quantity = v.new_remaining_quantity, updated_at = NOW() FROM valid_target v WHERE h.sku_id = v.sku_id RETURNING h.sku_id, v.quantity_diff ), updated_sku AS ( UPDATE product_sku s SET stock_quantity = s.stock_quantity + u.quantity_diff, updated_at = NOW() FROM updated_hot u WHERE s.id = u.sku_id RETURNING s.id ) SELECT (SELECT requested_count FROM stats) AS "requestedCount", (SELECT matched_count FROM stats) AS "matchedCount", (SELECT invalid_count FROM stats) AS "invalidCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_hot) AS "hotUpdatedCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated_sku) AS "skuUpdatedCount"
